title: Just Asking Gets You $1,400 Back From Your Bills
hook: Nine out of ten people who call their cable company to cancel get a discount instantly — and most Americans never make that one call.
angle: Bill negotiation is a systematic, repeatable move that takes two minutes but most people never try because they assume bills are fixed
audience: Anyone paying cable, internet, insurance, gym memberships, or medical bills — basically everyone
key_numbers: $1,400 average annual savings from bill negotiation
90% of retention calls result in a discount
80% of hospital bills contain billing errors
Up to 40% off available from cable/internet retention departments
76% of Americans have never tried to negotiate a recurring bill
